tipo: Três conceitos artísticos para escolha visual — não são modelos nem capturas Godot
portao: A e B aprovados; integração funcional C pendente
orientacao_do_usuario: Três variações diferentes da oca, com estilo mais triangular e vegetação parecida com a do jogo para integrar ao cenário.

variacoes.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single original architectural concept render for the Brazilian strategy game 1500. Input image 1 is the PRIMARY STYLE AND VEGETATION REFERENCE: match its actual achievable low-poly Godot game rendering, faceted tropical trees, broad green leaves, ferns, bromeliads, warm reddish-ochre earth, high color contrast, turquoise/jade/lime plant palette and golden late-afternoon sunlight. Input image 2 is ONLY the compact hut on its LEFT as the scale/subject starting point: replace its rounded silhouette with the requested new triangular design; do not reproduce the comparison sheet or right-hand longhouse. The user wants a compact first dwelling that belongs to this exact forest, with roof vegetation visually related to the broad leaves already in the game. Use clearly constructed timber supports tied with plant fiber and overlapping broad palm-leaf panels in green, olive, and restrained dry straw, as a plausible-looking stylized natural-material shelter. Treat the design as an artistic proposal, not an authenticated Tupinamba reconstruction. Same elevated three-quarter camera showing entrance, side and roof, whole hut visible, architecture fills about 65 percent of frame, same golden lighting and forest backdrop. Simple intentional game-ready polygonal shapes and crisp readable leaf panels, not photorealistic thatch strands or excessive microdetail. Small open dark entrance, wooden supports with fiber ties. No people, no symbols, no feathers, no textiles, no European chalet/cabin details, no log-plank walls, no bricks, no nails, no metal, no glass, no chimney, no furniture, no other buildings, no separate campfire, no porch, no tourist pavilion, no dramatic fantasy glow, no UI. No parchment border. Label only with the specified small clean top text and footer 'CONCEITO VISUAL — 1500'. VARIATION 1: a compact true triangular cross-section, steep symmetrical two-slope A-frame roof whose leafy eaves descend nearly to the ground. Short rectangular footprint, broad rich jade/olive palm leaves layered like the game's vegetation, with a few naturally dried gold tips and subtle irregular edges. Triangular front with a modest dark entrance at the bottom framed by lashed slender dark timbers. Strong clear pointed ridge. Avoid looking like a camping tent or European cabin; material construction should read as woven/lashed tropical plant material. Top text exactly '1 — TRIANGULAR COMPACTA'.
